## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: Test exercises both code paths (bm25s importable/stubbed + unavailable), asserts stderr notice only in fallback case ← sc-3
- dd-5: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Context
Extend tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py with 3 new test functions exercising both code paths via monkeypatch+importlib.reload. Tests MUST fail before task-2 implementation lands.

Required test functions:
1. test_ref_query_uses_bm25s_when_importable — monkeypatches sys.modules with stub bm25s module, reloads ref_query, asserts _BM25S_AVAILABLE is True and no [ref-query] stderr notice
2. test_ref_query_falls_back_when_bm25s_missing — sys.modules['bm25s']=None+reload, asserts exit 0 + stdout results unchanged + stderr contains [ref-query] line
3. test_ref_query_notice_emitted_once_per_process — fallback config, invoke ranking twice, assert [ref-query] notice appears exactly once

Use fixture/in-process seed corpus. Do NOT add bm25s to pyproject.toml.
